title: Double Free in µD3TN BPv6 Fragmenter Block Duplication allows Unauthenticated Remote Attacker to Cause DoS on…
description: A double free vulnerability exists in the µD3TN BPv6 Fragmenter Block Duplication component, which can be triggered by an unauthenticated remote attacker. This flaw can cause a denial of service (DoS) condition due to allocation failure. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
